title: Inventory Locked
description: this mod reduces the player inventory size
body:
## Description :
All the mod does is lock/disable all inventory slots except the hotbar. Disabled slots cannot be moved. Configurable via Mod Menu.

bugs can be reported on [Github](https://github.com/vanishd-dev/inventory-locked/issues).

## Required mods :
- [oωo-lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/owo-lib)
